reply.text: {"say":"Every lower-body movement is single-leg, starting with the Bulgarian split squat and finishing with a single-leg curl and calf raise, so each side works on its own.","title":"Single-Leg Day","days":[{"name":"Single-Leg Day","exercises":[{"key":"dumbbell-bulgarian-split-squat","sets":4,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Same reps on the weaker side first, match on the other."},{"key":"single-leg-dumbbell-romanian-deadlift","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Hips square, slow lower."},{"key":"dumbbell-step-up","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Drive through the working leg only."},{"key":"single-leg-leg-press","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Full range, no push off the other foot."},{"key":"single-leg-glute-bridge","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Pause at the top."},{"key":"single-leg-seated-leg-curl","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":""},{"key":"single-leg-calf-raise","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Pause at the bottom stretch."}]}],"unmet":[]}
